IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Nelson, Hudgins, Hasegawa, Santos, and Upthegrove

Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the South Park bridge as a highway of statewide significance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating South Park bridge as a highway ofstatewide significance; and adding a new section to chapter 47.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature designates the South Park bridge, which crosses theDuwamish waterway and is located in King county, as a highway ofstatewide significance.
